name: Omega 1
developer: Omega Data Centers / Océinde / THD Group
notes: Carrier-neutral Tier III-oriented data center in Le Port. DCD reported inauguration/live status, 1 MW, 120 racks, EUR10m investment; AFD primary financing page identifies SAS Omega Data Centers as beneficiary for construction/exploitation of a 95-bay data center on a 4,000 m2 site at the entrance to Le Port, connected near METISS subsea cable.

name: SFR Le Port
notes: Data Center Map lists SFR Réunion operating a data center at 3 avenue Théodore Drouhet, 97420 Le Port. Capacity not disclosed in accessible public sources.

name: SFR Sainte-Clotilde
notes: Data Center Map lists SFR Réunion operating a data center at 21 Rue Pierre Aubert, 97490 Sainte-Clotilde. Capacity not disclosed in accessible public sources.

name: NXO OI Saint-Denis
notes: Data Center Map lists NXO OI at 16 rue Albert Lougnon, 97490 Saint Denis, as a sovereign ISO 27001 and HDS-certified data center. NXO's own cloud page references NXO Cloud Océan Indien and HDS certification, but accessible source does not disclose site capacity.

name: Université de la Réunion Data Center
notes: Data Center Map lists a campus data center at 15 Avenue René Cassin, 97490 Sainte-Clotilde, operated by Université de la Réunion; DCD reports French MSP Exodata operates a facility at the University of Reunion in Saint-Denis. Capacity not disclosed.

name: Stor Solutions local data centers
notes: Stor Solutions says it added a second data center based in La Réunion in October 2021 and markets local data center/cloud resilience services. Zinfos974 reported the company's inauguration of a new datacenter in September 2011. Capacity and exact current site addresses were not disclosed in accessible sources.
